title: MiCA CASP Authorisation & Capital Readiness Checker
description: Assesses whether a Crypto-Asset Service Provider meets MiCA authorisation requirements ahead of the July 1 2026 end of national transitional periods. Covers capital floors, customer asset segregation, AML/Travel Rule, whitepaper obligations, and EBA Feb 2026 PSD2 dual-authorisation opinion for EMT handlers.
